description: This source file implements the 'MigrationPreparerImplementation' class, which manages data storage, component readiness, and migration reset functionalities within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace. It includes methods for handling key-value data, component readiness files, and various reset operations, along with helper functions for string manipulation and escape sequences.

classes.name: MigrationPreparerImplementation
classes.description: Class responsible for migrating data, managing component readiness states, and performing reset operations.

methods.name: escapeSed
methods.description: Escapes special characters in strings for use with sed based on specified sedType (PATTERN or REPLACEMENT).

methods.name: storeKeys
methods.description: Reads and stores keys from the DataStore file into internal data structures.

methods.name: resetDatastore
methods.description: Deletes the DataStore file and clears internal mappings and counters.

methods.name: resetMigrationready
methods.description: Deletes the migration ready status file.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a string by a delimiter into a list of substrings.

methods.name: join
methods.description: Joins a list of strings into a single string separated by a delimiter.

methods.name: isDuplicate
methods.description: Checks if a string already exists in a list.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes or updates a key-value pair in the data store, handling creation, update, and insertion.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads the value associated with a key from the data store.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a key-value pair from the data store.

methods.name: setComponentReadiness
methods.description: Adds a component name to the readiness list, maintaining sorted order and avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: getComponentReadiness
methods.description: Retrieves the list of components for migration readiness.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Performs reset operations based on reset type: all, data only, or readiness only.
